Name: Cherry Blossom Candle
Author: RiverinaPearl
Description: This mod adds a Cherry Blossom Candle in game, But there will be more Spring (and Maybe the other season) related Candles in the future if I get ideas! This was made in about 1 Hour so I don't expect the Candle to be very good since all day I've been working on another Candle mod. So I hope you guys enjoy this little mod!
